0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Eurydome has a use for your unique charms.

24.original: Speak with the Bureau of the Architect envoy.

25.original: Deliver the collection of crystallized concepts to Eurydome.

48.original: Oh my, aren't you adorable! Hmm... Actually, there's something you might be able to help me with.

49.original: A visitor from the Bureau of the Architect has arrived at Propylaion to deliver new concepts. I would like you to offer her the warmest of welcomes!

50.original: Normally, we'd have our own familiars attend to such duties, but most of them are already entertaining other guests. There's been rather a lot lately, you see.

51.original: On the other hand, this would be the perfect opportunity to show her an entirely new and─What's a nice way to put this?─<hex:021A020203>idiosyncratic<hex:021A020103> familiar. That being you, of course. I'm sure she'd be delighted to meet you!

52.original: Oh, you'd like some sort of description would you? Well, I believe she has a white mask and long, black robes. Does that narrow it down?

54.original: Eurydome chose her representative well, it would appear. As a matter of fact, I too have an errand to ask of you, namely the delivery of these concepts.

55.original: I have brought them all the way from the Akadaemia Anyder. Three aquatic fauna specimens from the Words of Mitron and one flora sample from the Words of Halmarut. All <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> fascinating, as my counterparts here will soon discover.

56.original: It would also be prudent to remind Eurydome not to let their captivating nature distract her from making her observations. Well then, there's no time like the present!

57.original: I trust our guest was as enamored with you as I am?

58.original: New concepts for us? And fascinating to the point of being distracting? What an odd thing to warn me about, though it does all sound rather intriguing.

59.original: The Akadaemia Anyder always produces concepts of the most outstanding quality, and I'm eager to learn what treats we have in store on this occasion. Let me see...

60.original: Hmm... From the Words of Mitron we have what seems to be an aquatic mollusk capable of storing aether in its shell. I can only guess as to what purpose that would serve, but I daresay all will become abundantly clear in due course.

61.original: Oh, I do apologize! I already find myself mesmerized by these concepts, just as our visitor predicted. For your part in bringing me these wonders, you have my thanks.
